An ice crystal falls vertically from a cloud.
What happens to the acceleration of the ice crystal as it falls?
A
It decreases because of air resistance.
B
It decreases because of gravity.
C
It increases because of air resistance.
D
It increases because of gravity.

options.label: A
options.text: It decreases because of air resistance.

options.label: C
options.text: It increases because of air resistance.
